subject: Math
text_verbatim: Chapter 1 Numberland Adventures: Up to 999 192 = 1 hundred, 9 tens and 2 ones 120 = 1 hundred, 2 tens and 0 ones We start comparing from the greater place value. 1 hundred = 1 hundred, we move to the tens place. 2 tens is less than 9 tens. 120 is less than 192. 120 < 192 greater than equal to less than Did you notice that the crocodile mouth is ALWAYS open towards the bigger number! Practice Questions Let's compare a few numbers using these symbols. a. 738 379 b. 482 482 c. 648 846 d. 356 567 e. 256 267 Let's arrange numbers from smallest to largest. Look at hundreds place first: 108, 120, 192 have 1 in hundreds 432, 438 have 4 in hundreds For numbers with same hundreds (108, 120, 192): Compare tens: 0, 2, 9 So: 108 is smallest (0 tens) Then 120 (2 tens) Then 192 (9 tens) Hundreds Tens Ones 1 0 8 1 2 0 1 9 2 4 3 2 4 3 8 11

exercises.label: Ordering worked example (ascending, part 1): 108, 120, 192 (same hundreds digit)
exercises.instruction_verbatim: Let's arrange numbers from smallest to largest. Look at hundreds place first: 108, 120, 192 have 1 in hundreds. 432, 438 have 4 in hundreds. For numbers with same hundreds (108, 120, 192): Compare tens: 0, 2, 9. So: 108 is smallest (0 tens), then 120 (2 tens), then 192 (9 tens).
exercises.answer_key: Ascending sub-order so far: 108, 120, 192. (Where 432 and 438 fit is resolved on the next page.)
